notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 1 or 2 damage to Spitemare.
description:
Deal exactly 1 or 2 damage to Spitemare.
Rite of Passage and Spitemare trigger twice.
Resolve both Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spitemare.
Resolve the first Spitemare trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to it to any target.
Resolve the second Spitemare trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to it to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
